official_draft_defects_preserved_as_note: The pinned identifier regex does not prove a valid FQDN and permits fewer than the documented namespace plus terminal-name segments; the local profile requires both.

The pinned schema exposes capitalized TrustManifest while normative text, CDDL, and JSON-LD use lower-case trustManifest; the local profile rejects the capitalized form and validates lower-case explicitly.
The pinned schema describes @id equivalence but does not enforce it; the local profile requires @id to equal identifier.
The byte-identical pinned schema retains a mutable main-branch $id; the local loader identifies it by vendored path and verified content hash instead of resolving that URL.
The pinned OpenAPI document still reports info.version 0.5.0; this package pins behavior by commit rather than trusting that field.
Official federation defaults to auto in the proposal; this package implements no federation behavior and grants no network dereference authority.
The registry URL examples are ambiguous between a base and a search endpoint; these examples advertise repository artifacts only and do not claim a deployed registry endpoint.
